title: Made a browser roguelite with Claude Code + AI art: loot dead spaceships before the reactor blows
author: reznichukm
selftext:
Hi! Wreckers is a free action roguelite that runs in the browser (phone or desktop). I'm a solo dev: the design, balance and direction are mine, AI did a lot of the heavy lifting.



How AI was used:

\- Code: Godot 4 / GDScript written with Claude Code. The game logic is a pure simulation with \~85 automated tests, and a bot plays hundreds of runs per zone to check the balance.

\- Art: intro illustrations and store covers generated, 3D models built with Blender scripts.

\- Audio: trailer music made with ElevenLabs.



The game: you board derelict ships in a ship graveyard, fight their security robots, grab loot, find the reactor core and sprint back to your shuttle before it blows. Runs take 6–10 minutes. You only steer and dash, your gun fires on its own.



Some rooms are special: siege rooms that lock you in with waves of robots, laser vaults you cross with a dash, cryo pods with a survivor to escort home, mimic crates that run away. During the countdown loot is worth x1.5 (x2 in the last minute), and if you get greedy a rival salvager, the Hunter, comes for you. Guns drop in four rarities with affixes; between runs you upgrade your salvage tug.



Play free: [https://playgama.ai/play/vgdgdwykpahrtf](https://playgama.ai/play/vgdgdwykpahrtf)

English, Ukrainian, Russian.



Feedback I'd love:

1. Did the first run hook you, or did it drag?

2. Does anything feel "obviously AI" in a bad way?

3. Anything unfair on mobile?
